text:
By Ashley Mezewich ,
53 minutes ago (GIF courtesy of GIPHY // NFL) Pittsburgh Steelers 2026 Season: 5 Games To Look Forward To The 2026 NFL season is not quite here yet, but let’s take a look at five Pittsburgh Steelers games to look forward to.
1 and 2. Week 15: Vs. the Baltimore Ravens; Week 18: Vs. the Baltimore Ravens It was Week 18 of the 2025 season. The Ravens and Steelers were matched up. The winner would make the playoffs, while the other would not.
The Steelers managed to walk away with the 26-24 victory and the No. 4 seed in the AFC.
The Week 15 game is one to look forward to based on this recent history, as it will be their first matchup of the season. However, it will be even more interesting if Lamar Jackson and the Ravens are at their best.
As for Week 18, will the aforementioned history repeat itself? Or will the Steelers find themselves in a completely different situation than they were at the end of 2025, already securing a playoff spot?
If the Ravens are playing well, this could be a great final matchup against a tough opponent to secure momentum for the playoffs -if the Steelers make it again.
The Steelers swept the Ravens in 2025 and won the AFC North title, while the Ravens finished second in the division.
If it looks like both teams could secure the division title in 2026, these two matchups will certainly be ones to watch.
3. Week 13: Vs. the Houston Texans The Steelers got demolished by the Texans in the Wild Card round in the 2025 season playoffs, losing 30-6.
Are the Texans really better than the Steelers in a head-to-head matchup? Or was this just a bad game by Pittsburgh?
Fans will have a greater sample size to determine this answer thanks to this matchup.
Jacksonville Jaguars 2026 Season: 5 Games To Look Forward To 4 and 5. Week 12: Vs. the Denver Broncos; Week 2: Vs. the New England Patriots With this being Aaron Rodgers ‘ last season , it will be interesting to see how competitive the Steelers are in the 2026 season.
Matchups against teams that made the playoffs in the 2025 season will be a great way to gauge this, especially against the teams that were the top two seeds in the AFC.
